title: key_rotate SPKI header constant duplicated from keygen
description: In crates/transit/src/cli/key_rotate.rs, the SPKI_HEADER constant ([0x30, 0x2a, ...] for ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER) is duplicated verbatim from cli/keygen.rs. If the serialization format changes, both must be updated in sync. Extract to a shared constant in stoa_core::signing or the keygen module.
